chunks: Equal are not the living and the dead. Verily God makes those He will to listen; but you cannot make those hear who are in their graves.

key_terms.الْأَمْوَاتُ: The dead (those without spiritual life/deaf to guidance)
key_terms.يُسْمِعُ: He makes to hear / grants hearing

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the living and the dead in terms of hearing divine guidance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Fatir (The Originator) distinguishes between the spiritually alive who respond to divine call and the spiritually dead, while also affirming the Prophet's limited ability to guide those in their graves. It underscores God's absolute sovereignty in granting 'hearing' (sama') and understanding, a concept central to the doctrine of divine grace (tawfiq) and the intercessory role of the Ahl al-Bayt.
